newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese net foreign bond buyers in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Japanese net foreign bond buyers in 1996/97.

text.p: Net purchases of foreign bonds by Japanese investors totalled 8.8111 trillion yen in the fiscal year ended March 31, 1997, after net purchases of 7.9512 trillion yen in 1995/96, the Ministry of Finance said on Wednesday.
Bonds include beneficiary certificates but exclude all bills.
Net buying of Japanese stocks by foreign investors amounted to 3.3884 trillion yen in 1996/97 compared with net purchases of 6.9832 trillion yen in the previous fiscal year, the ministry said.
Details of Japanese and foreigners' investments in billions of yen, were as follows:

Japanese stocks: Net Japanese bonds: Net
Figures are rounded and based on settlements.
